ai_assisted_development_policy.ai_code_review_focus: Deep-dive human review required for inventory math (D1 batch transactions) and Stripe webhook signature validation.

slices.description: Create a `settings` table in D1 to manage the `checkout-v2` feature flag in real-time without redeploying the Worker.
Implement checkout API endpoint to create order and 15-minute soft-lock. MUST use pure D1 `db.batch()` for atomic transactions to prevent race conditions.

Implement Stripe webhook handler. MUST use `idempotency_keys` table to prevent duplicate processing. Data Minimization: Log ONLY `stripe_event_id`, `order_id`, and `status` to `audit_logs` (NO full payload).
Implement Cloudflare Worker Cron handler (hourly) to mark `pending_payment` orders > 24h as `abandoned`. MUST use pagination (LIMIT/OFFSET) to avoid Worker timeouts.
Implement `POST /api/cart/coupon`. Strict Limit 1: DELETE existing `order_discounts` for the cart and INSERT the new one.

progressive_delivery.rollback_trigger: Checkout 5xx error rate > 1% OR Stripe webhook failure rate > 0%
progressive_delivery.observability_requirement: Log all inventory soft-lock collisions and webhook signature failures.

impact_and_gates.impact_radius: Critical path: Checkout and Payment. A bug here halts all revenue.
quality_gates: Unit tests for soft-lock expiration logic.
Unit tests for webhook idempotency logic (Mandatory).
Stripe CLI local webhook testing must pass before merge.

documentation_deltas: Update README with Stripe webhook setup instructions for local development.
Document D1 `settings` table schema for feature flags.
